articles.title: Javi Rodríguez: “Voy a intentar hacer los mejores años posibles”
articles.standfirst: Celebra la ampliación de su contrato con el Celta hasta 2030
articles.summary: Celebra la ampliación de su contrato con el Celta hasta 2030
articles.body: Javi Rodríguez amplió su contrato con el Celta hasta el año 2030: “Muy feliz y muy agradecido al club por apoyarnos y ayudarnos. Siempre están de diez. Darles las gracias y esperemos que esta temporada sea igual. Intentaré dar lo mejor de mí en estos años por los que he renovado”. Hace dos años que dio el salto al primer equipo: “Empecé debutando en la primera jornada y en esa temporada no esperaba jugar tantos partidos y la segunda, con la participación en Europa, fue increíble. Ahora a intentar hacer aquí los mejores años posibles”. Resalta la importancia de Giráldez en su carrera y los consejos del entrenador: “Siempre digo que Claudio me dijo que mejorara físicamente pero tengo mucho margen de mejora y tengo que seguir haciéndolo en cada partido, en lo físico y en la confianza con los compañeros. Mejorar en defensa y dar un poco más en ataque”. Espera celebrar la renovación con una mejora de su equipo en lo numérico: “No comenzamos muy bien la temporada con puntos pero el juego del equipo está siendo bueno y en el último partido ya vimos que si hacemos todo lo que nos dice el entrenador podemos ganar, como así hicimos. Esperamos seguir con esta racha hasta final de temporada y ver hasta dónde llegamos”. Preparado para partidos exigentes que llegan: “Viene un mes bastante duro con muchos partidos y bastante exigencia. Primero centrarnos en el Elche, que será bastante complicado, y después ya veremos lo que viene. Tenemos que estar todos bastante preparados”. Y tiene un mensaje para los seguidores célticos: “A la afición agradecerle el apoyo que siempre recibimos, tanto mis compañeros como yo. Darles las gracias y esperemos que esta temporada sea igual”.

articles.title: Rakan se declara inocente y BlueBay pide su libertad
articles.standfirst: La Fiscalía pidió prisión provisional comunicada y sin fianza
articles.summary: La Fiscalía pidió prisión provisional comunicada y sin fianza
articles.body: Rakan Al-Thani se declaró inocente y compareció por vía telemática ante la jueza de instrucción María de los Ángeles Ruiz González. El hijo de Abdullah Al-Thani apareció en pantalla apoyado en unas muletas. La vista, que comenzó por la tarde, se prolongó durante algo más de una hora y terminó con mucha menos repercusión de la que se podía esperar. De hecho, antes de las 18:30 horas ya habían salido todos los abogados de los Juzgados de Plaza de Castilla. Nada que ver con la expectación que en otros momentos han generado los procedimientos judiciales relacionados con el Málaga CF. Esta vez fue una comparecencia mucho más discreta y centrada en las cuestiones estrictamente judiciales. En la sala estuvieron los representantes de las distintas partes personadas en la causa. Entre ellos, José María Fernández Mochón, por la Asociación de Pequeños Accionistas; José Carlos Aguilera, en representación de Management Empresarial (BlueBay); y Sergio Verdier, por parte del Ayuntamiento de Málaga. La conexión telemática de Rakan Al-Thani generó además algunos problemas técnicos que dificultaron la comunicación en determinados momentos. La Fiscalía pidió prisión provisional comunicada y sin fianza para Rakan Al-Thani. Una petición que también respaldaron la Asociación de Pequeños Accionistas y el Ayuntamiento de Málaga, al considerar que existe un riesgo de fuga. La posición de BlueBay fue diferente y llamó especialmente la atención. Por decisión de Jamal Satli Iglesias, su abogado solicitó la puesta en libertad del hijo del sheikh. Ahora toca esperar a la decisión de la jueza. Las partes recibirán la resolución por vía interna a lo largo de la tarde, por lo que será entonces cuando se conozca el futuro inmediato de Rakan Al-Thani. La principal incógnita es si quedará en libertad o si, por el contrario, tendrá que pasar su primera noche en España en Soto del Real.

articles.body:
One of the biggest games of the college football season is reportedly still on as scheduled.

Andy Staples of On3 reported Thursday the plan is to still play the game between Alabama and Georgia on Saturday at 7:30 p.m. ET despite the development of Hurricane Isaias.

According to The Weather Channel , the storm "is still gaining strength and is headed for a Gulf Coast landfall Friday night with storm surge, rainfall flooding and high winds. It will then spread its heavy rain inland over the East this weekend."

Expert CFB Predictions for the Biggest Week 6 Games 🔒

Staples noted the storm is now projected to move through Tuscaloosa, Alabama, on Saturday morning and ahead of the scheduled game time.

ESPN's College GameDay previously announced it is moving its pregame show inside the Coleman Coliseum on Alabama's campus with doors scheduled to open at 5:30 a.m. CT and the show set to begin at 8 a.m. CT.

The show typically takes place outside on the campus of the hosting school, but safety concerns with the inclement weather necessitated the move.

While there is an 80 percent chance of rain during the day with winds up to 30 mph in Tuscaloosa on Saturday, The Weather Channel projects the winds to drop down to around 10 mph with a 40 percent chance of rain by the night.

Weather could impact the game, but it seems like conditions are trending in a direction that will allow it to happen.

It's a massive game, as both teams are undefeated and looking to earn a critical win in the race for the SEC championship and College Football Playoff. The Bulldogs are No. 2 in the country, while the Crimson Tide are No. 6 and fresh off an impressive 33-point win over Mississippi State on the road.

Georgia has a win over Oklahoma, but Saturday will be a step up in competition for both sides.

The Georgia defense against Alabama quarterback Keelon Russell will be the matchup to watch. Another impressive game for Russell could propel him up the Heisman Trophy rankings, while the Bulldogs defense can send a message to the rest of the country that it is one of the best units in the sport.

articles.title: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander apuesta por el Atlético de Madrid: será nuevo inversor
articles.standfirst: El ganador de dos premios MVP consecutivos y campeón de la NBA ha decidido invertir en el conjunto rojiblanco
articles.summary: El ganador de dos premios MVP consecutivos y campeón de la NBA ha decidido invertir en el conjunto rojiblanco
articles.body: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander se ha unido al Atlético como accionista. El jugador se ha identificado con los valores del Atlético de Madrid, tales como la ambición, la excelencia y la convicción de que cada logro debe ganarse con esfuerzo. Shai ha afirmado: "Estoy emocionado de unirme oficialmente al grupo de accionistas del Atlético de Madrid. Este es un club con una larga trayectoria en lo más alto del fútbol europeo, y agradezco la oportunidad de formar parte de su futuro". Nacido en Toronto en 1998 y criado en Hamilton, Ontario, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander desarrolló su carrera en Canadá antes de pasar una temporada en la Universidad de Kentucky. Actualmente es la pieza clave de los Oklahoma City Thunder y uno de los jugadores más destacados del baloncesto global. Gilgeous-Alexander ha logrado ser el jugador más valioso de forma consecutiva (MVP) de la NBA, campeón de la liga en 2025 y MVP de las Finales de 2025. Durante la temporada 2025/26 promedió 31,1 puntos por partido con un 55,3 % de acierto en tiros de campo, convirtiéndose en el primer jugador exterior en la historia de la NBA en promediar al menos 30 puntos con un 55 % o más de acierto. También alcanzó la barrera de los 30 puntos y el 50 % en tiros por cuarta temporada consecutiva, una hazaña que entre los jugadores exteriores solo ha igualado Michael Jordan. Batió el récord de la NBA de más partidos consecutivos de temporada regular anotando al menos 20 puntos, superando la marca de 126 encuentros de Wilt Chamberlain y ampliando su racha a 140 al final de la temporada. Más allá de las estadísticas, su capacidad para rendir bajo presión y su compromiso con la evolución constante encajan con los valores de intensidad, orgullo y ambición del Atlético de Madrid. Su inversión refleja un interés genuino en la visión a largo plazo del Atlético y en su crecimiento internacional.

articles.summary: El técnico babazorro compareció ante los medios antes de enfrentarse al Atlético
articles.body: Quique Sánchez Flores compareció a 48 horas de volver a la competición para recibir al Atlético en Mendizorroza. El técnico madrileño, intervenido esta semana de una rotura en el menisco, tiene clara la receta para hacer un gran partido ante el conjunto colchonero. Operación de rodilla: “Me rompí en verano la raíz del menisco y no tenía más remedio que operarme. Nos hemos adaptado y dentro de poco estaré bien. Me gusta jugar a fútbol y correr, quiero volver a hacerlo y tener normalidad en los entrenamientos. No me podía ausentar de la pretemporada, que es el momento más importante de la temporada y lo hemos hecho ahora”. Claves partido: “Vamos a intentar evitar ciertas cosas que sean incómodas y nos puedan quitar energía durante el partido. Son peligrosos, tienen mucho nivel y hay fases de partido en las que juegan muy bien. Intentaremos hacer nuestro partido y apoyado en nuestra gente”. Potencial del Atlético: "Ellos físicamente tienen datos muy fuertes porque tienen gente muy dotada. Cuentan con dos unidades que utilizan durante los partidos. Intentaremos que nuestras cualidades se sobrepongan a un rival que sí nos hace el campo grande y corre, va a ser peligroso”. Ville Koski: “Vamos a esperar a mañana. Está evolucionando y las noticias son buenas. Hasta que no tengamos el alta definitiva no vamos a hacer cábalas”. Parón liguero: “Yo viví esta situación en el Valencia. Sé nos iban 12 o 14 jugadores y nunca supimos cuál era la fórmula correcta. Nunca supimos si poner el 70% de los que se iban, el 60% de los que se quedaban... No sabemos si nos beneficia que el Atlético haya estado sin 15 jugadores en el parón, lo que sí sabemos es que son grandes jugadores”. Simeone: “Tiene una idea muy clara y estricta. Ha evolucionado y no siempre juega a lo mismo. Tiene momentos donde cambia la altura de las presiones. Que un equipo transite o domine no es casualidad. Le tengo una gran estima y es un gran entrenador”. Atlético: “Siempre que me enfrento al Atlético me cruzo con amigos que siguen trabajando. También está Koke, que hace 16 años que debutó, y ahí sigue”. Situación tabla: “Para hacer algo extraordinarios tenemos que ser ejemplares. Tenemos que hacer las cosas muy bien. En el momento que bajemos un poco el nivel, nos vamos a alejar de pasar una temporada feliz. Me niego a vivir una temporada como la pasada”. Resultado: “Puntuar sería un buen resultado y un muy buen resultado sería puntuar haciéndolo bien. Vamos por bloques. El primer bloque ya está jugado y disfrutado. Ahora afrontamos el siguiente, tenemos unos partidazos y vamos con la mayor ilusión del mundo”.

articles.summary: El canterano, que se ha afianzado este curso en el primer equipo, amplía su vínculo
articles.body: El Barça del presente y del futuro está en marcha. El club catalán confirmó hoy, de forma oficial, la ampliación de contrato de uno de sus futbolistas de mayor proyección: Xavi Espart. El Barcelona hizo oficial esta jornada la renovación del joven jugador de Vilassar de Mar. El canterano azulgrana, de 19 años, se vincula con la entidad culé hasta junio de 2030. El polivalente profesional, que juega en los dos laterales y en la medular, extiende su relación con el Barça en dos campañas más. El internacional sub 21 dio el salto al bloque de Hansi Flick el curso pasado, en la que intervino en seis encuentros, aunque sólo en uno fue titular (contra el Sevilla en LaLiga) y sumó 189 minutos. Pero fue este pasado verano, durante la pretemporada, cuando realmente llamó la atención del preparador germano. Espart, que llegó a La Masia en el verano de 2015 procedente de la UE Vilassar de Mar en categoría benjamín, se ha convertido este curso 26-27 en un hombre importante en la zaga del primer equipo azulgrana, siendo protagonista en el lateral izquierdo. El canterano culé, que también juega en el ala derecha de la defensa y en la medular, incluso ha adelantado en el once a Alejandro Balde, y alterna la titularidad con Joao Cancelo. Su proyección ofensiva provoca que incluso haya estrenado incluso su casillero goleador: marcó contra el Levante. Su renovación, que conllevará también una adecuación de su ficha, confirma la apuesta de la Dirección Deportiva por el Barça del futuro. Espart es uno de los jóvenes jugadores nacidos en el 2007 y que están triunfando en el Barça, como Lamine, Cubarsí, Bernal...

articles.title: Do Kirby Smart and Georgia still have an Alabama problem? It's time to find out
articles.summary: For a competitor like Smart, who has built Georgia into a perennial power, there is no great explanation or excuse for having such an anomalous record agains...
articles.body:
Despite being ranked No. 2 by the pollsters, Georgia is probably the safest answer right now to the question of who's the best team in college football.

If you're measuring everything — offense, defense, talent, experience, coaching and consistency — there is a week-in, week-out reliability to Georgia that hasn't really changed in a decade.

Except when they see the crimson helmets with numbers on the side.

On one hand, Saturday's showdown in Tuscaloosa between the SEC's two dominant powers will have all the trappings of a massive event: "College GameDay" in the morning , a prime-time television slot at night and even a scheduled visit from the President of the United States.

On the other hand, an early October meeting between Georgia and Alabama feels a bit like a warm-up act given the strong possibility they'll see each other again in the SEC championship game or the College Football Playoff with a lot more on the line.

But from a Georgia perspective, the biggest source of intrigue might be whether coach Kirby Smart has finally solved his Alabama problem.

"I see every game in the conference as a big game," Smart said this week. "This one has a more storied recent history because of the matchups and two divisions where they ended up pitted against each other and the meaningful games we've played against each other in the recent 10-15 year history."

Yeah, Kirby — and because you've lost most of them.

At this stage of Smart's career, we could shower him with almost endless praise for restoring his alma mater to glory. In fact, of all the accomplishments that will one day land Smart in the College Football Hall of Fame, the most impressive might be how he's powered Georgia right through all the changes in college football and pretty much has the same program now that he did in the pre-NIL/transfer portal era.

If you look around college football, all the major contenders have gone through some level of upheaval as they adapted to the new world — some for better, some for worse. But Georgia? It's basically the same product, year after year, draft pick after draft pick, championship after championship.

What once seemed like a Nick Saban-specific issue has oddly extended into Kalen DeBoer's tenure, with Smart entering Saturday's game just 2-7 against Alabama.

In the broader context of Smart's career, it's mind-blowing. He's 8-2 against Florida, 9-1 against Tennessee, 10-1 against Auburn, 8-1 against Georgia Tech, 3-1 against Texas and 2-0 against both Clemson and Oklahoma.

In 11 seasons, Smart has lost a total of 21 games. Seven of them have been to the Crimson Tide.

That's why Georgia winning the rematch with Alabama last season in the SEC championship game, 28-7, was such a big deal. Though it didn't ultimately amount to much in the playoff, as Georgia lost to Ole Miss in the quarterfinals, it would have been a major demerit on Smart's résumé to be 0-3 against DeBoer after losing in both the 2024 and 2025 regular season with a superior team on paper.

This time around, you can't really claim Georgia is better than the Crimson Tide. As rock solid as the Bulldogs have looked, they haven't beaten anyone that will be consequential in the playoff picture. You could say the same of Alabama, but both the eye test and DeBoer's track record would suggest the 49.6 points per game they're scoring with 19-year-old sensation Keelon Russell at quarterback is the culmination of everything he's been building in Tuscaloosa.

It looks very real, almost like a super-charged version of what DeBoer had in 2023 with Michael Penix leading Washington to the national championship game.

"There's a lot more similarities to what he did there, but a lot of that has morphed into SEC pictures now because he's been in our league so long," Smart said. "They're really hard to defend because you don't feel like there's a play they don't have. They've got all of them in terms of the plays you have to stop."

Alabama has never looked better under DeBoer coming into a game against Georgia. That makes Smart's task more difficult Saturday. It also gives one of the great coaches in college football history a chance to completely change the trajectory of the only rivalry he's been on the wrong side of.

With Saban out of the picture, Georgia fans would have expected that process to already be well under way. Aside from the national championship game in 2021, when Smart finally broke through against his mentor — a good time to do it, no doubt — the Alabama matchup really terrorized him and often pressured him into bad decisions he wouldn't make against any other opponent.

Though Alabama is always going to have great talent, DeBoer is a totally different kind of coach and one who wasn't as innately familiar with Smart's tendencies as Saban after more than a decade working together.

But lo and behold, here came DeBoer in 2024 landing an uppercut on Smart with a 28-0 lead early in the second quarter that eventually became a wild 41-34 victory. Then, last year in Athens, DeBoer snapped Georgia's 33-game home winning streak with a 24-21 win. In that game, Georgia looked like it was driving for the go-ahead score early in the fourth quarter but couldn't convert a fourth-and-1 inside the 10-yard line and kind of sputtered out after that.

Though it was a poor performance by Georgia, it wasn't a significant loss. Georgia got its chance at revenge two months later and both teams ended up in the CFP. The same could very well happen this year, regardless of result. They can thank the 12-team playoff for ensuring that these games aren't all-or-nothing.

But for a competitor like Smart, who has maintained Georgia's program at the absolute highest standard for a decade, there is no great explanation or excuse for having such an anomalous record against a particular rival.

If Georgia is indeed the safest bet in college football this year, finally getting rid of its Alabama problem would be a great way to prove it.

articles.title: UK sport tickets: Price increases analysed for the Ashes, Wimbledon, Silverstone and more
articles.summary: The price of sports tickets and TV subscriptions are on the rise - so what is behind the increases and how are they justified?
articles.body:
At least £115 to watch a day of the Ashes in Birmingham - unless you are an Edgbaston member.

A minimum of £255 for a standard seat at the Wimbledon singles finals.

Prices starting from £289 for general admission to the British Grand Prix at Silverstone on raceday.

Those are the ticket fees British sports fans have been told a single adult must pay if they want to attend some of the country's most beloved sports events in 2027.

The cost of entry to elite sport in the UK has risen sharply in the 2020s, but attendances across the majority of sports are as strong as ever.

Even for armchair fans watching at home, the breadth and expense of television subscriptions can be a barrier to accessing sport.

So what exactly is behind the rise in prices, can the increases possibly be justified and what does it all mean for fans?

In a new BBC Radio 5 Live programme - The Price of Our Sport - BBC Sport has taken a look.

Fans reacted with anger when some of the ticket price rises for major events next year were announced earlier this summer.

The increase in Ashes ticket prices is stark - the minimum price the last time Edgbaston held a Test in 2023 was £65, a rise of £50 to £115 in just four years. Admission to other venues, including The Oval, is even higher.

Last time out in Australia, some seats were sold to fans at all five venues for between £16 and £22.

At Wimbledon next year, the most expensive standard seat for both the men's and women's singles finals will be £400, £50 more than 2026, and more than double the cost from 2017.

That still makes Wimbledon the cheapest of the four Grand Slams, but even a Centre Court ticket for the middle Saturday of the tournament now costs at least £130.

General admission for Grand Prix Sunday at Silverstone is up to £289 from £189 in 2021, while the cheapest allocated seat now costs at least £609, up from £276 five years ago.

And general admission to the 2027 Ryder Cup at Adare Manor, in the Republic of Ireland, will cost €499 (£434), compared with up to €260 (£220) in Italy in 2023.

And other events which took place this year laid bare just how much more fans are being charged.

Fans paid £150 to attend a day of The Open at Royal Birkdale earlier this year, compared to £95 at St Andrews in 2022.

Prices for the FA Cup final varied from £50 to £285 in 2026, compared with £50 to £120 in 2016.

"It's just ludicrous," says Lee Hanlon, an England cricket fan who lives close to Edgbaston, but has decided not to attend next summer's Ashes because of the price rise.

"I'm angry. It seems like a lot of the normal cricket fans have been priced out. It seems like just people with money are going now.

"The increase is just too much. I find it upsetting."

But for event organisers, the prices chime with wider trends.

"We exist in an experience economy - we have definitely seen a subtle shift in the value people are placing on belonging, on the atmosphere you can be part of when you attend a live experience," says Mark Darbon, chief executive of the R&A, which operates golf's Open Championship.

"So when we set our prices we start by looking at some of the other major sporting events and benchmark ourselves, on price and value for money, by looking at what others are delivering."

How do organisers justify the ticket price rises?

In a poll on the BBC Sport website, 95% of respondents voted that tickets for the 2027 Ashes were too expensive.

A spokesperson for Edgbaston said: "Our entry-level ticket prices roughly match inflation compared to the last time Australia visited Edgbaston in 2023 - but like the rest of the country, we're battling increased costs and trying to manage these wherever we can."

Whether prices are set by governing bodies or the stadiums, the costs of putting on a major sports event include things like utilities, staffing, technology, insurance and marketing.

"Ticketing revenue generates less than 20% of our total revenue from The Open," Darbon says.

"We have seen really significant cost inflation in recent years. It now costs us 25% more than it did five or six years ago to host The Open - that could be £10-12m in incremental costs. We have to cover those costs."

Many prestige events and newly built venues also include an increased proportion of hospitality ticketing, which can drive up costs for fans wanting standard tickets.

"We are seeing more and more regular people willing to pay for a special experience at sport," says Richard Flint, chairman of Seat Unique, an online platform specialising in hospitality and VIP ticketing for events.

"Corporate boxes are being broken down more and more into individual seats, so it's less about people taking 10 of their colleagues and more about a couple, or four people, going together.

"[Teams and leagues] want to grow their revenue off the back of it, undeniably. Premium is much more open to people or go to one or two games a year, or who have travelled from abroad to come.

"Sometimes stadiums need updating and the revenue from premium ticketing can help fund a new stadium or new stand, so there are benefits to the everyday fan."

In a world with increasingly volatile economics and changing consumer habits, broadcasting live sport has been one of the more reliable ways for companies to generate revenue.

And live sport - and entertainment - is one of the few industries whose financial success is unlikely to be significantly compromised by artificial intelligence in the coming years.

That means more and more companies have taken an interest in buying the rights to show sports events, which means more TV subscriptions than ever before are necessary for fans wanting to watch all of the action.

A football fan in the UK, for example, must subscribe to Sky Sports, TNT Sports, Amazon Prime and Premier Sports, if they want to watch all of the matches across the Premier League, Champions League and Scottish Premiership.

And they must pay for an annual TV licence to watch other matches on the BBC and ITV.

Without taking advantage of special offers, other sports can require even more subscriptions and even more money.

"It certainly helps when you can say to a fan that they only need to buy one subscription to see everything in one sport," says Pete Oliver, CEO of growth markets for DAZN, a global sports streaming service.

"If a sport is very fragmented, we would say it's not going to be a great proposition for the fan [for us to be involved], and it's probably not going to be a great commercial prospect for us.

"The cost of entertainment [subscriptions] generally will increase over time.

"There is natural inflation in the market, there is a lot of competition for sports rights, the athletes want to be paid more money, and the leagues want to do what is right for them, and if they can get somebody to pay more for the content, they will"

In some sports, including Premier League football, the money which leagues and clubs are earning from TV rights is by far their biggest source of income, but has plateaued to an extent in recent years.

So broadcasters are not necessarily always shelling out significantly higher costs for rights, but fans are still being charged more to watch.

Increased competition, growing operational costs and an uncertain long-term financial model all play a role.

"I think in the short term, the fans who are not going to illegal solutions are going to pay more to watch sport," says Pierre Maes, author and consultant in sports media rights.

"But we have reached a kind of roof - people have to pay a lot [and] we know that higher prices and more fragmentation leads to more piracy.

"People seem to have no moral obstacle to going with piracy. You can say that's bad, and that it's theft, but the reality is that people don't care.

"The music industry had to deal with this problem. In the long term, I think there is no other path than a Spotify of sports.

"Otherwise, sports will lose their fans and lose their attention."

articles.title: Greece vs England: How Ella Toone’s Lionesses snub could boost her World Cup chances
articles.summary: Ella Toone was left out of England’s squad for the Greece play-offs after a difficult start to the season; she has responded positively; Sarina Wiegman has been impressed as midfield competition intensifies.
articles.body:
Toone was dropped for the World Cup play-off games against Greece after struggling for form at the start of the season with Manchester United.

England head coach Sarina Wiegman admitted Toone's performances had not been up to the expected standard and laid down a challenge for the two-time Euros winner.

The experienced head coach wanted to see how Toone would respond, both on and off the field. The results have impressed the usually stoic Wiegman.

A disappointed Toone accepted she would be watching the Greece games on TV and admitted to reporters after her last WSL game that she would use being dropped as "fuel to come back even better".

She then went to Spain to reset mentally and physically.

Instead of chilling out by the pool in Marbella, Toone put in the work to make sure she returned to her club in peak condition.

Then came the call from Wiegman - one gratefully received by the midfielder, even if she is likely to sit on the bench for the next two matches.

Toone does not care. She just wants to be part of things again, even if that means a last-minute scramble across Europe.

All of this has made Wiegman smile. She wanted a professional and motivated reaction from one of her go-to players, and she has got it.

Wiegman wants to take all her trusted lieutenants to Brazil, giving them the chance to go into battle together one last time before she calls time on her England tenure.

Toone is in that select group. It appears overcoming this setback has made her even more respected by her coach.

England have lacked depth in midfield in recent years. Since Fran Kirby's retirement, Toone, Keira Walsh and Georgia Stanway have largely been the first-choice trio.

Twenty-year-old Lexi Potter's form at Chelsea cannot be ignored, while Erica Meg Parkinson, who is just 18, is a regular starter in the National Women's Soccer League (NWSL).

Then there is Lucia Kendall, who is well-liked by Wiegman, while Laura Blinkilde Brown and Grace Clinton have just won the Women's Super League (WSL) with Manchester City.

Despite the increased competition, Wiegman admits big games "aren't the time for rotation".

That is another positive Toone can take from this situation.

If she can rediscover her best form for Manchester United, Toone can once again become the player Wiegman turns to when the stakes are highest.

England are planning for plenty of those occasions this season, and Toone appears determined to make sure she is there for as many of them as possible.

articles.title: El Almería renueva a Dzodic y se prepara para una futura gran venta
articles.standfirst: El club blinda al centrocampista serbio hasta 2032 tras su crecimiento meteórico y su reciente estreno con la selección absoluta de Serbia
articles.summary: El club blinda al centrocampista serbio hasta 2032 tras su crecimiento meteórico y su reciente estreno con la selección absoluta de Serbia
articles.body: La UD Almería ha decidido asegurar el futuro de Stefan Dzodic. El centrocampista serbio ha alcanzado un acuerdo con la entidad rojiblanca para ampliar su contrato dos temporadas más, hasta junio de 2032, en una operación que responde tanto a criterios deportivos como estratégicos. El club se garantiza la continuidad de una pieza clave para García Pimienta, pero también protege a uno de los futbolistas con mayor proyección de su plantilla de cara a una futura venta. En el Mediterráneo tienen claro que el internacional serbio está llamado a ser uno de los próximos grandes activos del club en el mercado. Una hoja de ruta que no es nueva en la entidad y que este verano tuvo otro ejemplo más con el traspaso de Dion Lopy al Al Ittihad por 13 millones de euros fijos, más otros seis en variables. La renovación de Dzodic encaja precisamente dentro de esa política de blindar a los jóvenes con mayor potencial para aumentar su valor y evitar que salgan sin una contraprestación acorde a su crecimiento. A sus 21 años, el centrocampista atraviesa el mejor momento de su carrera. Su progresión desde que llegó al Almería en el verano de 2025 ha sido meteórica. Procedente del Montpellier, aterrizó con la convicción de que podía hacerse un hueco en el primer equipo. En su presentación ya dejó claro que no pensaba en el filial, sino en competir con los mayores. El tiempo le ha dado la razón. Durante la pasada temporada fue creciendo hasta convertirse en un fijo para Rubi, disputando 33 partidos de Liga y los cuatro de los playoffs de ascenso. Ese rendimiento le abrió definitivamente las puertas de la titularidad y le permitió seguir evolucionando durante el presente curso. Su excelente nivel también ha tenido premio a nivel internacional. En este último parón debutó con la selección absoluta de Serbia, un escaparate que no hace sino incrementar su cotización. Antes de marcharse con su país había sido titular en seis de las ocho jornadas de Liga y únicamente se perdió los encuentros frente al Mallorca y al Burgos por su convocatoria internacional. Con este movimiento, el Almería envía un doble mensaje. Por un lado, refuerza la columna vertebral de un equipo que aspira al ascenso. Por otro, protege el patrimonio de un futbolista cuyo techo parece todavía muy lejano. En el club confían en que Dzodic siga creciendo de rojiblanco y, si mantiene esta línea ascendente, pueda convertirse en más pronto que tarde en otra gran operación de mercado para las arcas de la entidad.

articles.title: Se destapa un nuevo caso de apuestas en la Premier
articles.standfirst: Martin Sherif, jugador del Everton, ha sido multado por la FA
articles.summary: Martin Sherif, jugador del Everton, ha sido multado por la FA
articles.body: Los casos de apuestas en la Premier League se han disparado durante los últimos años: Ivan Tooney, Kieran Trippier, Daniel Sturridge, Harry Toffolo, Sandro Tonali... La lista no para de engordar y Martin Sherif ha sido el último en sumarse. De vuelta tras su cesión en el Port Vale el curso pasado, todavía no ha tenido minutos con el primer equipo del Everton en este inicio de temporada. Se ha visto envuelto, sin embargo, en un escándalo de apuestas... y él mismo ha admitido su culpabilidad en medio de las investigaciones. En total, se le relaciona, directa o indirectamente, con 61 apuestas en una serie de partidos comprendidos entre el 20 de noviembre de 2024 y el 12 de febrero de 2026. La FA informó que el mismo Sherif expuso no haber realizado ninguna de ellas... pero admitió que pertenecían a cuentas a su nombre que él mismo había financiado. En total, se invirtieron cerca de dos millones de libras. La comisión reguladora encargada de llevar el caso expuso que había mostrado un "auténtico arrepentimiento" por lo sucedido. La FA, ante ello, no le ha impuesto ninguna sanción deportiva... pero sí que deberá hacerse cargo de una multa económica que asciende hasta las 5.000 libras.

articles.title: La Fiscalía solicita 12 años de prisión para el médico de cabecera de Maradona
articles.standfirst: Leopoldo Luque es acusado de homicidio
articles.summary: Leopoldo Luque es acusado de homicidio
articles.body: La Fiscalía solicitó este jueves una pena de doce años de prisión y diez de inhabilitación profesional para el médico de cabecera de Diego Armando Maradona, el neurocirujano Leopoldo Luque, acusado del delito de homicidio simple con dolo eventual, al tiempo que solicitó penas de cuatro a diez años para otros cinco imputados y la absolución del séptimo. También por el delito de homicidio con dolo eventual los fiscales solicitaron una pena de diez años de prisión y otros diez de inhabilitación profesional para la coordinadora de cuidados domiciliarios de la empresa de medicina privada Swiss Medical Nancy Forlini, y ocho años de prisión con diez de inhabilitación para la psiquiatra Agustina Cosachov. Para el psicólogo Carlos Díaz el requerimiento fue de cinco años de prisión y diez de inhabilitación, mientras que para el jefe de enfermeros Mariano Perroni y para el enfermero Ricardo Almirón pidió cuatro de prisión y ocho años de inhabilitación, los tres acusados del delito de homicidio culposo. A diferencia del homicidio culposo, el homicidio con dolo eventual contempla que la persona era consciente de que sus actos podían conducir a la muerte y decide asumir el riesgo. Los fiscales pidieron, a su vez, la absolución del médico clínico Pedro Di Spagna, quien solo visitó a Maradona en una oportunidad y quien consideraron "no ha tenido potestad ni decisión para encaminar la salud del paciente". Maradona murió el 25 de noviembre de 2020 mientras cursaba un tratamiento domiciliario en el que los seis acusados por la Fiscalía este jueves "infringieron los deberes a su cargo, ejecutaron acciones contrarias al arte de curar, omitieron todos los actos que debieron ejecutar y colocaron a Maradona en una situación de desamparo, librándolo a su suerte", según consideró el fiscal Patricio Ferrari. En sus alegatos de cierre, los fiscales describieron el tratamiento como "anárquico, con dos jefaturas y con dos canales independientes de información y una misma característica común, la desorganización absoluta", apuntando así contra Luque, como médico personal de Maradona, por un lado, y contra Forlini, en tanto coordinadora de Swiss Medical, por el otro. El juicio comenzó el pasado 14 de abril ante el Tribunal Oral en lo Criminal (TOC) N° 7 de San Isidro, en las afueras de Buenos Aires, contó con 45 audiencias dedicadas a la producción de prueba, 75 testimonios y la exposición de un centenar de mensajes extraídos de los teléfonos de los acusados.

articles.title: Man City charges: Maresca says players focused on Liverpool test
articles.summary: Manchester City manager Enzo Maresca claims players unfazed by financial breaches verdict ahead of Liverpool showdown.
articles.body:
Manchester City manager Enzo Maresca has brushed off the guilty verdict hanging over the club and says he and the players are fully focused on football matters.

City could face a severe points penalty and even expulsion from the Premier League after an independent commission found they used “sham” commercial contracts to inflate revenue and cut costs by over 900 million pounds ($1.2bn) between 2009 and 2018.

City, who top the league with five wins in five games, return to action for the first time since the guilty verdict was revealed when they travel to Liverpool on Sunday.

The eight-time Premier League winners, who have appealed the decision , then play their first game in front of their own fans since the verdict, when they entertain back-to-back Champions League holders Paris Saint-Germain on Wednesday.

“I am very calm, the club has been quite calm. We trust completely the club,” Maresca told City’s in-house media on Thursday.

“We understand the noise, but the focus for us is what we control and we control the football side.

“The feeling is fantastic, to be honest.”

Maresca, who was assistant to former manager Pep Guardiola during the 2022-2023 season, addressed the players for the first time since the verdict when they returned to training on Thursday following the international break.

When asked about the reaction of the squad – many of whom have been linked with a move away from City if the club’s appeal fails – Maresca said they were “excited” given their start to the season.

“The players are excited for the next two games, but especially they are excited because in this moment, we are top of the league, so the players they are just focused ‌‌on that,” he said.

“They know that what we can control is the football side. They are not worried at all about different things. They know they are professionals.

“They know that the noise is there, but they don’t care too much about the noise.

“They are just focused on this moment, how we can beat Liverpool, how we can, together with the fans, try to win at Anfield.”

As part of City’s appeal against the decision they have continued to maintain their innocence, saying the independent commission’s opinion contains “clear material errors” and that they possess evidence supporting their position.

The commission also found the ⁠⁠club guilty of charges relating to their failure to cooperate with the investigation.

Premier League holders Arsenal begin the weekend’s action in the top flight on Saturday when they entertain Leeds United with the chance to move level on points with City, who would then hold Sunday’s game in hand.

articles.title: Eagles Snap Up Center after Steelers Tryout
articles.summary: The Philadelphia Eagles signed center James Brockermeyer to their practice squad on Wednesday, just a few days after he tried […]
articles.body:
The Philadelphia Eagles signed center James Brockermeyer to their practice squad on Wednesday, just a few days after he tried out for the Pittsburgh Steelers .

Brockermeyer was one of nine players and four offensive linemen that the Steelers hosted for tryouts at UPMC Rooney Sports Complex on Friday, along with Andrew Coker, Gus Hartwig and Tomas Rimac for tryouts on Friday.

Instead, he signed with the practice squad of the Eagles, who traded away starting center Cam Jurgens to the Baltimore Ravens on Wednesday.

Brockermeyer, 24, was an undrafted free agent this spring out of Miami, who spent time with the Atlanta Falcons this training camp and preseason. He was a starter at TCU in 2024 and with the Hurricanes in 2025, when he won a national championship.

The 6-foot-3, 298-pound Brockermeyer posted average athletic testing numbers in the pre-draft process, putting up 28 bench press reps and running a 5.30-second 40-yard dash as part of a 5.46 Relative Athletic Score out of 10.

In three preseason games with the Falcons, he appeared in 120 snaps all at center. In 67 pass protection opportunities, he allowed jus three pressures, per Pro Football Focus.

articles.title: Vikings villain Drew Brees will call Saints game — and receive halftime honor
articles.summary: FOX's analyst for this week's game happens to be the greatest player in the home team's franchise history.
articles.body:
Drew Brees has a busy Sunday coming up. The greatest player in New Orleans Saints history will be the analyst on FOX's call of Saints-Vikings, alongside play-by-play announcer Adam Amin and sideline reporter Kristina Pink. In that role, he'll be expected to call the game from an unbiased national perspective.

Then, at halftime, Brees will bolt out of the TV booth at the Superdome and be honored as a franchise legend. He's set to be inducted as the ninth member of the Saints' Ring of Honor in a halftime ceremony. Brees is also going to receive his Pro Football Hall of Fam Ring of Excellence on Sunday, although it's unclear when exactly that presentation is happening.

Brees' Ring of Honor induction has been scheduled for this date since August . It seems reasonable to wonder if the Saints officials who selected the Vikings game for the ceremony did so coincidentally or if there was some intention there, given the history between the two teams.

"It will be a privilege to recognize Drew as a member of our Ring of Honor in October," said Saints GM and EVP Mickey Loomis. "Drew's production and character both on and off the field sets him apart as the greatest Saint ever. This is a great opportunity for our organization and our fan base to show appreciation for his Hall of Fame career."

It just so happens that Brees will also be calling the game before and after the ceremony. He's in his first full year calling games for FOX after being hired to replace Mark Sanchez as Amin's broadcast partner last season.

It'll be interesting to see if Brees is able to prevent his understandable bias from sneaking into his commentary and analysis on Sunday's game.

During his 15-year career with the Saints, Brees played the Vikings seven times in the regular season and went 5-2. More notably, he faced the Vikings three times among his 18 career playoff games. Brees' Saints beat the Vikings in controversial fashion in the 2009-10 NFC championship game, on their way to a Super Bowl victory. They also lost in dramatic fashion in 2017-18 (the Minneapolis Miracle) and 2019-20 (Kyle Rudolph's overtime touchdown).

Brees was enshrined into the Pro Football Hall of Fame this summer.

articles.title: Thunder's Shai Gilgeous-Alexander joins ownership group of La Liga's Atlético Madrid
articles.summary: The back-to-back NBA MVP has said that soccer was his first sport growing up in Canada.
articles.body:
Oklahoma City Thunder star Shai Gilgeous-Alexander has joined the ownership group of Spanish soccer team Atlético Madrid, it was announced on Thursday .

"I'm excited to officially join Atlético de Madrid's ownership group," Gilgeous-Alexander said in a statement. "This is a club with a long-standing presence at the top of European football, and I'm grateful for the opportunity to be part of its future."

The back-to-back NBA MVP is joining the La Liga side as an investor and shareholder.

The club, which has won 11 league titles, 10 Copa del Reys, 3 UEFA Europa Leagues and 3 UEFA Super Cups, currently sits in second place in the La Liga table , five points behind leaders Barcelona.

Atlético de Madrid, founded in 1903, has featured numerous legendary players including Luis Aragonés, Jan Oblak and Antoine Griezmann, among many others.

Gilgeous-Alexander helped the Thunder to the 2024-25 NBA title, while also winning NBA Finals MVP during that playoff run. He is a four-time All-NBA First-Team player and All-Star and led the league in scoring two seasons ago.

He also has a long-time connection with soccer. In a 2025 Q&A with fans through GQ magazine, Gilgeous-Alexander revealed the game was his first sport growing up in Hamilton, Ontario. He's also developed a friendship with Real Madrid star Vinícius Júnior and linked up with him two years ago in Spain.
